input: Search the web for youth sports or skill "clinics" held in the summer for kids and teens in Haywood, Jackson and Swain counties, NC (Waynesville, Canton, Sylva, Cherokee). Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.
searches: Waynesville Canton youth summer sports clinics 2025 2026
